acceptance.definition: positive time/CPU increase must not exceed compressed-byte savings percentage; changed frame decode measured in one binary; identical-frame decode has identical code and input

limits: synthetic DAT corpus; no guarantee for all arbitrary inputs
shared host; CPU affinity is not exclusive CPU isolation
four compression samples per version; twelve same-binary decode samples per variant
identical-frame decode raw timing differences are retained but do not represent changed algorithmic work
no full bootstrap suite, real device, WAN, production peak or 512MiB load measurement
